text: If, immediately before the commencement of these regulations, a person: (a) was a delegate of the Registrar of Trade Marks under the repealed Act; and (b) was exercising the powers of the Registrar in relation to a matter to which, under Division 3 of Part 22 of the Act, the repealed Act continues to apply; the delegation of that person continues in relation to the matter.
title: Certain delegations continue

units.text: If, immediately before the commencement of these regulations, a person:
(a) was a delegate of the Registrar of Trade Marks under the repealed Act; and
(b) was exercising the powers of the Registrar in relation to a matter to which, under Division 3 of Part 22 of the Act, the repealed Act continues to apply;
the delegation of that person continues in relation to the matter.
